phases: Who Did It, and Who Says So

listenings.text: Good afternoon, and thank you for joining our third quarter results call. I will start with the commercial line. Prices were reviewed in all four regions during the quarter, and a new benchmark was introduced for the fresh categories. As a result, a gain of two hundred and forty million was reported in commercial efficiency, and this figure has been audited by our external firm. I want to be clear about one point, because it was raised by two of you last quarter. No store was closed to reach this number. The gain was delivered by pricing work alone. The full disclosure is available in the document that was published this morning on our investor page.

Hi everyone, quick briefing on the new sign-off rule, because it starts on Monday. Until now, a price change under five percent was approved inside the commercial team. From Monday, every change above the threshold must be signed off by two people, and the reason must be recorded in the system. I know this sounds heavy. It is not about trust. It is about disclosure: when the regulator asks why a price moved, the answer has to be found in one place, not in six email threads. Any variance above ten percent will also be reviewed by the compliance team. If you have questions, they should be sent to me before Friday. Thanks.

extra_audio.text: First, a new benchmark is set for the category. Then the prices are reviewed in all four regions. After that, every change above the threshold is signed off by two people. Next, the results are audited by an external firm. Finally, the gain is reported in the official release.

paras: During the year, the pricing model was rebuilt at SKU level and a new benchmark was set for eleven categories. The work was carried out by the commercial efficiency team over nine months.

A gain of two hundred and forty million was reported in commercial efficiency. This figure has been audited by an external firm and is included in the full disclosure on page forty-one. No store was closed and no headcount was reduced to reach it.

A new sign-off rule was introduced in the second half of the year. Every price change above the threshold is now approved by two people, and any variance above ten percent is reviewed by the compliance team before it is released to the stores.
The board has been informed that the model will be extended to the remaining categories next year. The results of that extension will be reported in the next annual report.

gist.prompt: Read once for the main idea. Why is almost every sentence written in the passive?
choices: Because the writer does not know who did the work
Because the focus is the decision and the number, not the person
Because the passive is the only correct form in English reports

items: The pricing model was rebuilt at SKU level.
The first line says the model was rebuilt at SKU level.
Stores were closed to reach the gain.
The report says no store was closed and no headcount was reduced.
The figure was audited by an external firm.
The second paragraph says it has been audited by an external firm.
One person alone can approve a price change above the threshold.
Every change above the threshold is approved by two people.
